# Jay Beniza - UI/UX Designer

> Portfolio of Jay Beniza, a UI/UX designer in the Philippines with 3.5+ years of experience designing web and mobile products, from research to final interface, and building them in React.

## Pages

- [Home](https://jaybeniza.vercel.app/): featured work, areas of expertise (UI/UX design, design systems, front-end development) and testimonials
- [Work](https://jaybeniza.vercel.app/work): every project - UX case studies, client platforms and personal builds
- [About](https://jaybeniza.vercel.app/about): background, design process, work experience, skills, certificates and awards
- [Get in touch](https://jaybeniza.vercel.app/get-in-touch): contact form for projects and roles

## Case studies

- [BiteWise](https://jaybeniza.vercel.app/bitewise): mobile grocery shopping concept shaped by dietary needs - research, insights and design decisions

## Client and team projects

- [GuRover](https://jaybeniza.vercel.app/gurover): AI-assisted, offline-first workspace for Philippine teachers
- [COMELEC Gamified 3D for ACM](https://jaybeniza.vercel.app/comelec-acm): 3D interactive game teaching election personnel how the Automated Counting Machine works
- [PSGS](https://jaybeniza.vercel.app/psgs): minimally invasive surgery training for the Philippine Society of General Surgeons
- [Central App](https://jaybeniza.vercel.app/pci-central-app): design system of foundations and components for a company central application (2024)
- [AACCUP](https://jaybeniza.vercel.app/aaccup): accreditation information for Philippine state universities and colleges
- [DOST ARISE](https://jaybeniza.vercel.app/dost-arise): STEM learning platform for teachers and students

## Personal projects

- [Portfolio 2026](https://jaybeniza.vercel.app/portfolio-2026): this site, designed and built end to end
- [Portfolio 2022](https://jaybeniza.vercel.app/jaysonbeniza): second portfolio site
- [Portfolio 2022 (First Edition)](https://jaybeniza.vercel.app/jbnza): first portfolio site
- [ReGain](https://jaybeniza.vercel.app/regain): student mental health support platform, a capstone project
